fields.statement: Verifier at 8e79a2706: go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./tools/gate passed all five tests. TestPlanOnePackageAndDependents runs -dry-run in a temp git repo and shows that a change to internal/a lists go test ./internal/a ./internal/b (its reverse dependency) plus cmd/rhiza, not internal/c or make test, then make self-check. TestPlanRhizaOnly shows a .rhiza/-only change lists make self-check alone. TestPlanFallbacks shows that an empty RHIZA_GATE_BASE and a go.mod change each list make test and make self-check. TestPlanScripts shows a changed foo.txtar plus an acceptance naming TestScripts/bar lists -run 'TestScripts/(bar|foo)$'. grep -n "rhiza.ship.localGate 'make gate'" AGENTS.md matched lines 95-96. I also dry-ran the tool on this repo. Base HEAD~1 shows a Makefile change, so it falls back to make test plus make self-check. HEAD~3..HEAD~2 (internal/api plus describe-golden.txtar) lists internal/api with its reverse dependencies, then cmd/rhiza under the test lock with -skip '^TestScripts$', then TestScripts/(bar|describe-golden|foo|ship-local-gate)$, then make self-check. Minor observation: bar and foo come from this leaf's own example acceptance text and match no scripts, which does no harm. A .rhiza-only commit lists make self-check only. The diff matches the leaf: make gate runs go run ./tools/gate, tools/gate changes trigger the fallback, and cmd/rhiza steps run under the flock test lock. go vet and gofmt are clean.
